The main takeaway from our work is that

the Steinberg cross sections can be generalised to the non-connected affine K–M case and the twisted Coxeter elements can be generalised from the connected affine K–M groups to the non-connected case.
the twisted Coxeter cells are in a certain sense “as nice” as the ordinary Coxeter cells.
